summary: A regulatory and operational day for Indian retail, with FSSAI taking action against Nestle India over baby food claims, while leadership changes signal strategic shifts at health tech and restaurant platforms.

bullets.text: FSSAI filed three adjudication cases against Nestlé India over '5 HMOs' and 'easy-to-digest' whey claims in infant nutrition products.
Karnataka High Court suspended life sentences of seven convicts in Yogesh Gowda murder case.
L Catterton acquired minority stake in South Indian restaurant chain Nandhana Foods for $30 million.
Practo elevated Shashank ND to executive chairman and appointed Jagnoor Singh (ex-Bharti Airtel, Unacademy, OYO COO) as CEO.
Reliance Jio began investor meetings ahead of its IPO listing.
